buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidders should have registered with GST in Local. (Documents to be uploaded). Past work experience for three years with the same type of services will be considered for evaluation. Breakdown calls should be attended immediately. Emergency call on Sunday if any may be attended. Terms and conditions as mentioned in the Circular vide G.O.Ms.No.652/DIT/D1/2025/ Dt.15.05.2025 of the Directorate of Information Technology, Puducherry must be followed. The AMC payment will be made four equal installments in every year. Availability of Office of Service Provider must be located in the state of the Consignee. If equivalent standby Computers/Printers should be provided within 24 hours. Incase Desktop Computer is downtime penalty Rs.500/- per day after 48 hours for every day/part thereof. Incase Printers are downtime penalty Rs.250/- per day after 48 hours for every day/part thereof. Copy of the report on issue of each equipments should be sent the Inspector (Stores) retaining a copy with the contractor.

The vendor should attend the call within a minimum possible time without waiting for two days. Since the j ob of the Police is of urgent in nature and 24 x 7. The vendor should attend periodic preventive maintenance, atleast once in every quarter and corrective maintenance on receipt of complaints. The recoveries will be effected from the cost installment of AMC amount. The vendor should replace the defective products/parts with similar or higher make/configuration of respec tive OEM products/parts for desktop computer and Printer. Keyboard and Mouse should be replaced on branded only Dell/ACER/HP refurbished not accepted. Printer’s mother board should be replaced on branded only HP/Canon refurbished not accepted. .
